messages:
Anya: FYI — customer support case says decrypt events missing from audit for their private VPC deployment (key k-123).
Tyler: which env/region? link to the case?
Anya: eu-west-1, ACME-Corp, support# CS-4892. saw their redacted timeline request.
sec-bot: automated: audit-schema-migration completed (audit_v2) at 1972467000
Maria: heads-up — audit_v2 renamed `principal` -> `actor_id` and added `redaction_reason` optional. backfill was kicked but looks partial.
Tyler: query I'd run to confirm:
```
SELECT event_id, timestamp, operation, resource, actor_id, redaction_reason
FROM audit_events
WHERE resource = 'kms.decrypt' AND key_id = 'k-123' AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();
```
Oncall-SRE: ran a similar query on the index — events exist but ~7% have `actor_id` = NULL and `redaction_reason` = 'backfill-redacted'.
Samir: checked backfill job logs: older records hit a redaction policy for service accounts that didn't have `principal` mapped. we preserved `event_id` and `operation` but removed actor.
Anya: customer wants a validated timeline proving decrypts occurred, without exposing PII. they asked for per-event non-reversible proof (signed digest).
Maria: proposed workflow:
  1) create sanitized export with fields: `event_id`, `timestamp`, `operation`, `resource`, `redaction_reason`
  2) compute and attach HMAC-SHA256 over the CSV using our KMS signing key (or platform HMAC key)
  3) include manifest with schema version and `audit_v2` note
Tyler: can we also include an append-only proof (hash chain) so customer can verify ordering? avoids revealing actor details.
Oncall-SRE: quick checks: IAM change logs show no policy edits in the window; KMS service logs show successful decrypts from `svc/redwood-inference@redwood-prod` principal for that key.
Samir: action item: update backfill to attempt rehydration of `actor_id` from KMS usage logs where available, otherwise set `redaction_reason`='service-account-redacted' and keep event_id stable. PR ETA EOD.
Anya: I'll draft the customer-facing package: sanitized CSV + signed digest + manifest + instructions for verification. need legal sign-off on wording.
Maria: I'll coordinate with Legal and Support on the wording and the level of detail to disclose (no IPs, no IAM identities).
Tyler: also add to post-incident checklist: 1) run full audit-sanity query for all private deployments 2) ensure backfill preserves event_id 3) publish migration note in eng-security.
Anya: filed INC-2026-512 for the investigation and customer deliverable. linking ticket in the case.
sec-bot: automation: created ticket INC-2026-512, triggered export job job-842
Samir: opening PR #3487 to change backfill logic, will include unit tests for preserving event_id and `redaction_reason` enum.
Oncall-SRE: I pushed a quick dashboard showing `kms.decrypt` events with null `actor_id` for the last 90d.
Anya: thanks everyone — will update the case after Legal review. :thumbsup:
